falsification_conditions.condition: BTC/USD closes above $73,500 on any daily candle within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A close above the August 2024 breakdown level would invalidate the bottom_2024_aug pattern match, as that pattern requires price to remain below the prior support-turned-resistance zone. Breaking above would signal a structural reversal, not a bottoming continuation.

falsification_conditions.condition: Funding rate on BTC perpetual swaps exceeds +0.05% for 5 consecutive 8-hour intervals while price is within 5% of the 30-day high
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained positive funding at elevated levels would indicate leveraged longs are aggressively piling in, contradicting the HOLD signal which assumes weak speculative demand typical of a bottoming phase. This would suggest a blowoff top is forming instead of accumulation.

falsification_conditions.condition: BTC spot ETF net outflows exceed $500 million in any single trading day, or cumulative outflows exceed $1.5 billion over any 5 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Massive institutional exodus would invalidate the bottom_2024_aug comparison, which was characterized by stabilizing or improving ETF flows. Sustained heavy outflows would indicate structural distribution, not the quiet accumulation phase the current HOLD verdict assumes.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
